task.title: Add end-to-end bounded autonomous source-to-search smoke
task.summary_zh: 把 source-ingest bounded fetch baseline 與 search durable index 收成 default-stack 可驗證的 end-to-end autonomous source-to-search smoke；不啟用任意 crawler 或 live web scraping。
task.phase: Service Hardening / Durable Source Search Pipeline
acceptance: compose smoke seeds bounded configured connector into source evidence store
search durable query succeeds without caller supplied documents
DLQ audit watermark behavior is covered by tests
request document compatibility stays explicit and quarantined
